address: 16-18 Radford Street, Stone, ST15 8DA, United Kingdom
bio: Little Seeds has a bright, fresh, natural look with green walls, foliage and rustic, upcycled furniture. A smattering of cookery books adds to the homely feel – and there’s a walled garden and drinks terrace out the back too. Great quality regional ingredients are used to create eye-catching British dishes with the occasional playful touch. The popular Sunday lunch menu features roast Staffordshire beef....
